title: Crash when spawning new window alongside neovim in an xfce terminal under i3

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

- Operating system/version:

- Terminal name/version:

xfce-terminal

- `$TERM`:

xterm-256color

### The crash

I use i3. Sometimes when I make a new window to the right of a terminal containing nvim, nvim crashes. Presumably this is something to do with the window size change code:

